valid.name: integer-scalars
valid.description: The minimum, maximum and a value of distinct bytes of every integer type

valid.name: float-scalars
valid.description: For each float type: a value that's exact, one that rounds, -0, both infinities, NaN, the largest finite value and the smallest subnormal one

valid.name: integer-arrays
valid.description: An array of every integer type, of its extremes, -1, 0, 1 and a value of distinct bytes

valid.name: float-arrays
valid.description: Arrays of the float values of float-scalars and 0

valid.name: empty-arrays
valid.description: An empty array of every element type. Their lengths are padded as they would be for elements, so the int64[] and uint64[] each follow 4 bytes of padding.

valid.name: padding
valid.description: A uint8[] of 0 to 7 bytes before each of eight float64[], of 0 to 3 bytes before each of four int32[] and of 0 to 1 bytes before each of two uint16[], so that the arrays are padded by every amount that they can be

valid.name: offset-size-1
valid.description: 1-byte offsets, lengths and counts after no header, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-1-sized
valid.description: 1-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a size slot, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-1-versioned
valid.description: 1-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a version slot of 255, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-1-sized-versioned
valid.description: 1-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a size slot and a version slot of 255, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-2
valid.description: 2-byte offsets, lengths and counts after no header, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-2-sized
valid.description: 2-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a size slot, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-2-versioned
valid.description: 2-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a version slot of 65535, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-2-sized-versioned
valid.description: 2-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a size slot and a version slot of 65535, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-4
valid.description: 4-byte offsets, lengths and counts after no header, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-4-sized
valid.description: 4-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a size slot, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-4-versioned
valid.description: 4-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a version slot of 4294967295, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-4-sized-versioned
valid.description: 4-byte offsets, lengths and counts after a size slot and a version slot of 4294967295, the largest that it holds, with a field of each kind: a scalar, arrays, a string, and a nested table and a vector of tables of the same offsets

valid.name: offset-size-1-full
valid.description: The longest table of 1-byte offsets, 255 bytes: its size, the length 250 of its uint8[] and the offset 254 of its last field are only read correctly unsigned

valid.name: strings
valid.description: Strings: empty, ASCII, with 2-, 3- and 4-byte UTF-8 sequences, with a leading U+FEFF, which is part of the string rather than a byte order mark, U+FEFF alone, with a NUL inside and mixing every sequence length

valid.name: nested-tables
valid.description: The same table nested from its builder, padded to 8 for its float64[]; from its bytes, padded to the default of 4 and then to 8; and from its builder with an alignment of 1, unpadded. Then an empty table from its builder, unpadded, and from its bytes, padded to 4.

valid.name: nested-two-deep
valid.description: A table nested in a table nested in a sized and versioned table, from the middle table's builder and from its bytes. The int64[] at the bottom pads both nested tables to 8.

valid.name: nested-narrower-offsets
valid.description: Tables of 1- and 2-byte offsets nested in a table of 4-byte offsets, from their builders, which are written with their own offsets, and from bytes. Each is read from its position with its own offset size.

valid.name: nested-wider-offsets
valid.description: Tables of 4- and 2-byte offsets nested from their builders in a table of 1-byte offsets. Each is read from its position with its own offset size.

valid.name: vectors
valid.description: Vectors of rows from their builders and of the same rows from their bytes, whose float64[]s are aligned within each row, but mostly not in the table, since items aren't padded; an empty vector; and a vector of an empty table from its builder and from its bytes

valid.name: vector-item-layouts
valid.description: A vector of a table read in place and then tables of other layouts, which are read from their items' bytes: of 2-byte offsets, which its builder writes and the vector copies; with a size and a version, written straight into the vector; and of 1-byte offsets with both, from bytes

valid.name: empty-table
valid.description: A table of no fields, which has no bytes

valid.name: empty-table-sized-versioned
valid.description: A table of no fields with 2-byte size and version slots

invalid.name: truncated-offsets
invalid.description: Cut inside the offset of the first field

invalid.name: truncated-array
invalid.description: Cut inside the last element of the last array

invalid.name: truncated-string
invalid.description: Cut inside the last character of the last string

invalid.name: truncated-offset-size-1
invalid.description: offset-size-1-full without its last byte, its last field

invalid.name: offset-past-end
invalid.description: The offset of the first field, an int8, points at the end of the table

invalid.name: array-length-past-end
invalid.description: The length of the last array counts one element more than the table holds

invalid.name: array-length-max
invalid.description: The length of the first array is 2^32 - 1, which a reader must not allocate

invalid.name: array-length-max-offset-size-2
invalid.description: The 2-byte length of the float64[] of offset-size-2 is 2^16 - 1

invalid.name: string-length-past-end
invalid.description: The length of the last string counts one byte more than the table holds

invalid.name: invalid-utf8-continuation
invalid.description: A string starts with a continuation byte, 0x80

invalid.name: invalid-utf8-overlong
invalid.description: A string has an overlong encoding of "/", 0xc0 0xaf

invalid.name: invalid-utf8-surrogate
invalid.description: A string has the encoded surrogate U+D800, 0xed 0xa0 0x80

invalid.name: vector-count-past-end
invalid.description: The item count of a vector is 2^32 - 1

invalid.name: vector-item-past-end
invalid.description: The length of the last item of the vector counts one byte more than the table holds

invalid.name: nested-offset-past-end
invalid.description: The offset of the string of the first nested table is 2^32 - 1, past the end even before it's added to the nested table's position
